arguments.proof:
intro a b h
apply ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add (a := a) (b := b)
intro ε hε hb
have hεreal : (0 : ℝ) < (ε : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hε
have hcoe : ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ) = (ε : ℝ≥0∞) := ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal
simpa only [hcoe] using h (ε : ℝ) hεreal
